info.title: EverEcho API
info.description: EverEcho v0.1 — a consent-first archive for a living person’s stories. Every archive-scoped route is authorised by the storyteller’s current consent policy before any data is read, and every AI-assisted answer carries claim-level citations.

There is no inactivity timer and no inferred death: releasing a living person’s archive to their family is not recoverable.

post.description: Returns the moment in a real recording where they answered, with a few seconds of lead-in, and a link to the original file. Nothing is generated and nothing is edited: the response carries one contiguous range of one recording, or none.
